messages:
devops-bot: pagerduty alert — GPU node gpu-prod-12 reported CUDA illegal memory access on container redwood-runtime-v3
mira: I'm on it. assigning to sam (runtime) and carla (sre). I'll handle comms.
sam: thanks. any recent deploys? checking logs now.
carla: I see flapping on gpu-prod-12, kernel oops entries: "misaligned address exception"; multiple containers restarted.
eli: fetching container logs:```
2026-03-15T11:41:02Z runtime ERROR: cuda: illegal memory access
stack: 0x7f8a3b2c -> 0x7f8a4c4f
...attn_kernel.c:line 432
``` 
fiona: rolling back last runtime patch (ae3d9) across us-west to test.
mira: @sam try cordon+drain gpu-prod-12 and restart runtime pods on gpu-prod-14 as failover. Keep node in maintenance.
sam: running: `kubectl cordon gpu-prod-12 && kubectl drain gpu-prod-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — will spawn pods on gpu-prod-14
sam: also limiting instance concurrency: set REDWOOD_MAX_CONCURRENCY=4 on deployment to reduce memory pressure.
carla: note: customers with dedicated capacity on gpu-prod-12 may see errors until we move them.
incident-bot: oncall handoff from @mira to @carla at 11:50 UTC — 30m escalation window.
mira: comfy with that. I'll post customer impact shortly.
eli: grpc logs show increased `INVALID_ARGUMENT` -> `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS` for model: llama-7b-aq.
fiona: rollback applied to canary, logs on canary look stable; no illegal access seen post-rollback.
sam: pods restarted on gpu-prod-14, health checks passing, but p95 latency for generation jumped from 1.2s -> 3.6s for CPU fallback requests.
carla: switching routing policy: route critical customers to dedicated pool in eu-west and disable autoscale to prevent cold-starts.
mira: customer impact: ~9% of hosted API requests erroring in us-west for models quantized-int8; no evidence of data exfiltration. Hit rate peaked at 12% at 11:46 UTC. Affected: hosted text-generation for models: llama-7b-aq, redwood-rl-3.
sam: next step: collect CUDA backtrace and open kernel/driver bug if reproduces. For now, blocked nodes are cordoned and pods evicted.
eli: snippet from `dmesg`:
```
[12345.678] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, PID 4821 illegal memory access at address 0x7f9b4c0000
[12345.679] NVRM: GPU at 65:00: driver 515.76
```
carla: marking incident severity P1 because customer-facing errors and node flaps. Paging active.
mira: action items: 1) keep gpu-prod-12 cordoned 2) propagate rollback to remaining clusters 3) prepare kernel/driver report 4) inform sales+support with impact note
fiona: rolling rollback to remaining canaries now.
sam: added temporary auth to route requests to cpu-pool for non-latency-critical customers. `route: fallback-cpu`.
carla: ETA for full mitigation ~ 40 minutes, monitoring for reoccurrence. will update every 10 mins.
mira: posting support blurb: "We're investigating GPU runtime errors causing elevated errors for some text-generation requests in us-west. We're routing traffic to healthy nodes and expect mitigation within 1 hour."
sam: tentative root cause: kernel/driver interaction with new continuous-batching path causing misaligned memory loads under high concurrency. will follow up with repro test.
mira: thanks team. tagging SRE lead @eli and runtime eng @sam for postmortem.
:thumbsup: reactions from @carla @sam
